name: gampeg
label: gamma Peg (Algenib, B2 IV, beta Cep pulsator)
sources: Wikipedia infobox (read 2026-10-08) and the papers it cites: V 2.84, B2 IV, beta Cep hybrid pulsator (P 0.15175 d), T_eff 22000 K, R 5.4 Rsun, M 8.8 Msun, d 144 pc, log g 3.95
notes: No interferometric diameter exists: theta_LD = 2R/d = 0.349 mas from the quoted radius and distance; the Pathfinder would be its first measurement.
Claret & Bloemen 2011 linear law of Spica (hot B star) as the limb-darkening fallback; NewEra does not cover T_eff > 12 000 K.
Radial pulsation P 0.15175 d (ΔV 0.11); a companion at 85.6 mas (2025) is excluded here.

summary.components: B2 IV, beta Cep hybrid pulsator (P 0.15175 d)
